title: Bytes: an accent is two bytes
notes: In UTF-8, é is two bytes, C3 A9. They occur together 11 times, so the first merge glues them back into é, and bébé encodes as b é b é_. The ê of fête also starts with C3 but occurs once and never gets a merge: it stays two bytes, ‹C3› ‹AA›, but it is still encoded.
ops: café*3 thé*2 été*2 bébé crème*2 tête
